newsitem.title: USA: Del. Otsego chief says talked with suitors.
newsitem.headline: Del. Otsego chief says talked with suitors.

text.p: Delaware Otsego Corp President and Chief Executive Officer Walter Rich said Wednesday he has been in talks with Norfolk Southern Corp and CSX Corp over a potential acquisition of the company.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, Rich said such talks with the two railroads over such a plan have already taken place in conjunction with the announced acquisition of Conrail Inc.

Rich, who holds the equivalent of a 14.9 percent stake in Delaware Otsego, said the talks are expected to continue about the "possiblity of participaing in a transaction involving the acquisition of the company or certain assets."

Rich's latest disclosure came a day after CSX Corp, which holds a six percent stake in Delaware Otsego, said in a separate SEC filing that it "continues to evaluate the possibility of participaing with others, consistent with regulatory requirements, in the acquisition of the company." -- Washington newsroom, ((202-898-8300))
